data.text:
Rahis vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 19 March, 
2024 
Author: Vivek Chaudhary
Bench: Vivek Chaudhary
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
? Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:23786-Db
Court No. - 2 
Case :- Writ - C No. - 2601 of 2024 
Petitioner :- Rahis
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Govt. Of U.P. Civil Secrt. Lko. And 2
Counsel for Petitioner :- Ambrish Kumar,Shiv Pal Singh
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1.  Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for State-respondents. 
2. Petitioner has approached this Court for issuance of a writ of mandamus commanding and directing the respondent No.3 to decide the application of the petitioner dated 26.09.2023 (Annexure No.1 to the writ petition) pending before him for licence of sell of buffalo meat. 
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that grievance of the petitioner would be sufficiently met, in case representation/application of the petitioner dated 26.09.2023 is considered and decided by respondent No.3 in a time bound manner to which learned Standing Counsel has no Rahis vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 19 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106224904/
1 objection to the same. 
4. Looking into the facts and circumstances of the case, without entering into the merits of the case,
respondent no.3- Prescribed Authority, Food Safety & Drug Administration Officer, Bahraich is directed to consider and decide the representation of petitioners dated 26.09.2023 (Annexure No.1 to the writ petition), in accordance with law, by a reasoned and speaking order, after hearing all the parties concerned, as expeditiously as possible say within a period of three months from the date a certified copy of this order is placed before him. However, while deciding the representation of the petitioner, respondent No.3 shall seek a detailed report from the concerned police authority and also the Municipal Authority as to whether the proposed shop falls in a commercial or in a residential area, as no commercial activity can be permitted in the residential area. 
5. With the aforesaid direction, present writ petition is disposed of. 
(Om Prakash Shukla, J.) (Vivek Chaudhary, J.) Order Date :- 19.3.2024 Shubhankar  Rahis vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 19 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106224904/
